svg.text: Hub (ESP32-S3 N16R8) with level sensor, RS485 module, display and power. Labels match the printing on each board.
flash through the port marked USB
XDA, XCL, AD0, INT: leave unconnected
Mount flat; X arrow toward the hitch.
VCC from the hub's 3V3 (not 5 V): keeps RO safe for the ESP32.
DE and RE on separate wires (no bridge needed).
connector row on the right edge
A to A, B to B (to the display RS-485 header). No data? Swap A and B.
Leave the display's 120R DIP switch as shipped.
5 V to hub 5V pin and display POWER 5V
GND: battery -, buck, hub, display, MPU-6050 and MAX485 all joined
• Wi-Fi: Beau Starlink, then the cloud (MQTT)
• Solder both 22-pin header rows on the hub.
• Check each board's printed labels before soldering wires.
• Turn the 12 V off before plugging a PC into either board's
USB, so two 5 V supplies never meet.
• Leave both display USB-C ports empty in normal use; power it
